source.notes: Genuine ISC 2019 board examination paper (Physics Paper 1, Theory, 861A) from the CISCE Archive Library bundle ISC-20191.zip; the year comes from the bundle (the paper itself prints only the code 1219-861A in its footer). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Cover: Maximum Marks 70, Time allowed Three hours plus 15 minutes reading time (not included in durationMinutes). The paper states 7 printed pages and 1 blank page; the PDF has the 7 printed pages. Section A: Question 1 (12 marks) = (A) five 1-mark MCQs [5×1] and (B) seven 1-mark short answers [7×1], stored as parts '(A)(i)'..'(B)(vii)'. Section B: Questions 2-12, 2 marks each; Section C: Questions 13-19, 3 marks each; Section D: Questions 20-22, 5 marks each. Internal-choice alternatives (a)/(b) separated by OR (Questions 4, 11, 15, 16, 20, 21, 22) share choiceGroup = the question number. Questions whose sub-parts carry no separate marks are kept together. Several symbols in this PDF are embedded as small images and are absent from the text layer: q/ε0 in Q1(A)(i) options, the unit after the capacitances in Q14, the Greek letter in Q9(b), the emf expression in Q20(b)(i) and the fringe-width relation in Q21(b); these are flagged, not rebuilt. Degree signs printed as a raised 'o' and small raised/lowered digits (m², C₁) were rebuilt after checking glyph size and baseline with pdfplumber. Q12 (frequency modulation, communication systems) is on a topic not in the current chapter list, so its chapter is null. Logic-gate and transistor parts of Q22 are mapped to the semiconductor chapter.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
